X-Vaulter-Api-Version response header on every response
X-Vaulter-Collab-Timestamp (unix seconds) and X-Vaulter-Collab-Signature (lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" with the hub webhook secret); a replayed signature is refused

X-Vaulter-Destination-If-Match request header of a move: the strong ETag of the destination folder as the caller reads it (the drive root for a null destination); a mismatch answers 412 node_sequence_mismatch and the folder sequence is checked again under the tree lock; part of the move fingerprint

Idempotency-Key request header: one Structured Field String ("…", \" and \\ escapes) or one token of visible ASCII without commas; 1-255 bytes, never trimmed or case-folded; Idempotent-Replayed: true on a replayed response
X-Request-Id: an accepted incoming id (also read from X-Correlation-Id) or a new ULID; echoed on every response
Tus 1.0.0 resumable uploads: Tus-Resumable, Tus-Version, Tus-Extension (creation,termination), Tus-Max-Size, Upload-Offset, Upload-Length, Upload-Metadata

lowercase hex SHA-256 over tenant_kind, tenant_id, scope_kind, scope_id, actor_kind, actor_id, operation, key, each as <byte length>:<bytes> and a null as ~; a user actor_id is <byte length of type>:<type>|<id> (sha256:<hex> of it beyond 191 bytes), a system actor_id null; request hash = hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON fingerprint (keys sorted, unescaped slashes/unicode)
If-Match header: one or more strong entity tags; weak tags never match; absent -> 428 precondition_required, no match -> 412

HS256 JWT: sub, sub_type (trusted host morph type), document_id, drive_id, tenant (exact nullable string), protocol, state_format, generation, schema_version, scope (read|write ceiling), permissions_version {drive, global}, room (<channel prefix>.<drive_id>.<document_id>.<generation>), iat, exp (min(iat + hub.token_ttl, grant.notAfter); now < exp + hub.clock_skew, actual skew 0..60 default30), jti

<module>.<resource>.<verb>, dotted lowercase segments, at most 64 bytes (OperationSpec::NAME_PATTERN); one name per mutating operation: documents.comments.add, documents.comments.delete, documents.comments.resolve, documents.documents.create, documents.documents.restore, documents.documents.set_retention, documents.documents.snapshot, documents.documents.update, documents.documents.update_content, drive.access.grant, drive.access.invalidate, drive.access.restore_inheritance, drive.access.restrict_inheritance, drive.access.revoke, drive.files.add_revision, drive.files.delete_revision, drive.files.restore_revision, drive.files.set_revision_retention, drive.files.upload, drive.folders.create, drive.nodes.copy, drive.nodes.move, drive.nodes.rename, drive.nodes.set_properties, drive.nodes.star, drive.nodes.trash, drive.nodes.unstar, drive.shares.create, drive.shares.revoke, drive.shares.rotate, drive.shares.update, drive.trash.empty, drive.trash.purge, drive.trash.restore, drive.uploads.abort, drive.uploads.complete, drive.uploads.initiate, webhooks.endpoints.deactivate, webhooks.endpoints.delete, webhooks.endpoints.redeliver, webhooks.endpoints.register, webhooks.endpoints.rotate_secret, webhooks.endpoints.update

receipt kind drive.access-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: grant, grant: every GrantSnapshot field (snake_case, subject_type/subject_id; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP)} or {type: revoke, revoke: {kind: grant, id, drive_id, node_id, ability}}

receipt kind documents.comment-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: comment, comment: every CommentSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; version)} | {type: deleted, deleted: {id, node_id, drive_id, by_author}}; a deletion keeps the basis of the right (author or Manage), never the comment
receipt kind documents.revision-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every DocumentRevisionSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP); no content

receipt kind documents.document-snapshot, version 1: JSON {node_id, document_id, type, schema_version, collab_protocol, collab_state_format, type_available, editable, epoch, state_version, dirty, head_revision_id, content: the JSON payload of the content (read back with ContentDecoder::read), revision: receipt-document-revision fields | null, content_hash, collab_state_size, updated_at (Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP), updated_by}
receipt kind drive.drive-snapshot, version 1: JSON {id, owner_type, owner_id, profile, name, status, tenant_id, created_at, version}
receipt kind drive.node-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every NodeSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; file/document/viewer heads or null)
receipt kind vaulter.problem, version 1: JSON {code, status, details} of a refusal whose code is receipt: cacheable; headers in receipt_headers
receipt kind drive.purge-receipt, version 1: JSON {kind: node|revision|trash, id, drive_id, scope_node_id, ability, count}; ids and the authorization scope only, never content
receipt kind drive.revision-snapshot, version 1: JSON of every FileRevisionSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP)

receipt kind drive.share-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: link, link} | {type: minted, link, token: Crypt::encryptString(raw token)} | {type: revoke, revoke: {kind: share, id, drive_id, node_id, ability}}; link = every ShareLinkSnapshot field (snake_case), never the token; the raw token is stored only as ciphertext (APP_KEY)

receipt kind drive.upload-session, version 1: JSON {id, upload_id, drive_id, protocol, status, received_bytes, total_size_bytes, chunk_size, mime_type, target_node_id, target_parent_id, target_name, expires_at}; no staged bytes, storage key or blob

receipt kind webhooks.endpoint-receipt, version 1: JSON {type: endpoint, endpoint: every WebhookEndpointSnapshot field (snake_case; times Y-m-d\TH:i:s.uP; version; no secret)} | {type: minted, endpoint: as above, secret: Crypt::encryptString ciphertext of the signing secret} | {type: deleted, deleted: {id, tenant_id, ability}} | {type: redelivered, redelivered: {id, endpoint_id}}; a deletion keeps the id and the scope the right was proven in, never the endpoint; a redelivery keeps the ids of the delivery and its endpoint, never the payload
JSON: id (event id), type, version (1), source (vaulter), time (UTC ms Z), tenant_id, drive_id, subject{type,id}, sequence, actor{type,id}, correlation_id, changes{seq}|null, data (object)
Standard Webhooks headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature (v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>), several secrets space separated during rotation
